youtube.title: How many fonts should your website use? Three, max

media.alt: Text-led reel with the K&A Performance logo and ka-performancefl.com at the top of every frame. Hook: Three fonts, max. One for headings, one for body text, maybe one for labels. A drawn dog grooming page, labeled Drawn example, not a real business, is set in seven fonts, each line tagged with its font: Courier New, Impact, Brush Script MT, Times New Roman, Georgia, Comic Sans MS, Papyrus, with a counter reading Fonts on this page: 7. Seven fonts, nothing leads. Then each font gets one job: headings in Schibsted Grotesk, body text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, labels in Lenia Mono. Size and weight do the rest, and the counter drops to 3. Then a real capture of K&A's web design page with its three fonts called out: labels Lenia Mono, headings Schibsted Grotesk, body text Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, and the line Your logo is artwork, it doesn't count. Ends on Want a site that speaks with one voice? ka-performancefl.com, web design from Gainesville, call Alex 904-210-1071.
